entities.summary: Songtsen Gampo, a notable figure in the history of Nepal, associated with Licchavi Dynasty (600–879). Preceded by Nepal as Cultural Bridge to Tibet and Changu Narayan Temple inscriptions — the oldest inscriptions in Nepal. Their legacy influenced Licchavi Princess Bhrikuti marries Songtsen Gampo, spreading Buddhism to Tibet and Jayasthiti Malla codifies the caste system and legal code of Nepal.
